title: Weather Forecast HUD
description: Tiny top-left HUD that shows current weather (Clear / Rain / Thunder) with intensity, a rising/falling trend marker, and an estimated time-to-change in singleplayer. Vanilla shows no forecast at all. Toggle with B.
body:
**Weather Forecast HUD** turns Minecraft's invisible weather timer into a one-glance badge. Vanilla never tells you whether it's about to rain, how long the storm will last, or how close clear skies are — you just stand in the rain and guess. This mod surfaces all of it.

### What it shows
A small two-line badge in the top-left corner:
```
Weather: Rain 78% +
Rain ends in 1m 12s
```
- **Line 1** — the current state (`Clear`, `Rain XX%`, `Thunder XX%`) plus a trend marker:
  - `+` rising — rain/thunder intensity is building up,
  - `-` falling — the storm is fading,
  - `=` steady — gradient hasn't moved this second.
- **Line 2** *(singleplayer only)* — a friendly countdown:
  - `Rain in 4m 20s` when it's clear,
  - `Rain ends in 1m 12s` when it's raining,
  - `Storm ends in 42s` during a thunderstorm.

Colors match the mood: cyan for rain, yellow for thunder, warm gold for clear skies.

### Controls
- **B** — toggle the HUD on / off (chat message confirms the new state).

The keybind uses raw GLFW polling so it works identically across every supported Minecraft version.

### Compatibility
Works on **Minecraft 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, and 1.21.11** (Fabric Loader 0.16+). One JAR covers all four versions.

- Pure client-side: install on the client only, works on any server, no game-state changes.
- Hides automatically when you press **F1**, and while any GUI screen is open.
- The time-to-change line only renders in singleplayer; on servers the badge stays at one line (percent + trend still work).
- No config file, no dependencies beyond Fabric API.
